title: Coherent normalized integral and finite signed presentations
statement: For any scheme X and the completed coefficient sheaf for D,l,E, there exist a normalized TensorPresentation a, its SignedSymmetry s, normalized ReductionPresentations m_n at every positive quotient, and their SignedSymmetries t_n. Both completed and finite swaps are natural in the two tensor inputs, and the completed and finite evaluation counits are natural in the first Hom input. There is no geometric dualizing object, constructibility, dimension, completeness, or biduality assertion.

source.place: Second paragraph: evaluation-defined delta and its naturality; structural K-flat tensor calculus.

proof.text: Take a and its finite reduction presentations from IntegralHom.models_exist. No new coefficient comparison construction is needed.

For each supplied tensor presentation, restrict the ringed-site closed tensor comparison and its presentation comparison to K-flat pairs. Full faithfulness of restriction along the product localization lifts their quotient to a natural tensor isomorphism. Conjugate the closed symmetric braiding by this isomorphism. Its naturality follows by the two naturality squares and braiding naturality. The signed chain swap and its representative equation follow by conjugating the symmetry model; the homogeneous generator at degree i+j is transported from degree j+i by add_comm. This is the fully proved private presentation_symmetry in Lean.

Choose the finite presentations and their transported signed symmetries pointwise. Apply the single-presentation first-variable evaluation naturality lemma once at completed coefficients and once at every finite coefficient. Assemble the four equations and the existing presentations.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 08J9 functorial currying, and Koszul symmetry in 06YL/06YU; transport along normalized tensor comparisons.

theorem signedCalculus
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ (a : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E X D hl))
      (s : SignedSymmetry X (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E X D hl) a)
      (m : ∀ n : ℕ, IntegralHom.ReductionPresentation l E X D hl a n)
      (t : ∀ n : ℕ, SignedSymmetry X (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)
        (m n).target),
      (∀ (K L K' L' : Ambient l E X) (f : K ⟶ K') (g : L ⟶ L'),
        a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫ (s.swap K' L').hom =
          (s.swap K L).hom ≫ a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom g f)) ∧
      (∀ (K K' W : Ambient l E X) (f : K' ⟶ K),
        a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 K')
          ((IntegralHom.hom.{u, u} X
            (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E X D hl)).map
            (Prod.mkHom f.op (𝟙 W)))) ≫ (a.adjunction K').counit.app W =
        a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f (𝟙 _)) ≫ (a.adjunction K).counit.app W) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (K L K' L' : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionTarget l E X n))
        (f : K ⟶ K') (g : L ⟶ L'),
        (m n).target.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫ ((t n).swap K' L').hom =
          ((t n).swap K L).hom ≫ (m n).target.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom g f)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (K K' W : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionTarget l E X n))
        (f : K' ⟶ K),
        (m n).target.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 K')
          ((IntegralHom.hom.{u, u} X (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)).map
            (Prod.mkHom f.op (𝟙 W)))) ≫ ((m n).target.adjunction K').counit.app W =
        (m n).target.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f (𝟙 _)) ≫
          ((m n).target.adjunction K).counit.app W)
